title: ▶️ Up to 40,000 people may have entered the Spanish autonomous city of Ceuta illegally from Morocco, El Confidencial reported, citing estimates by the Spanish Civil Guard.
text:
▶️ Up to 40,000 people may have entered the Spanish autonomous city of Ceuta illegally from Morocco, El Confidencial reported, citing estimates by the Spanish Civil Guard."

"According to the newspaper, migrants continued arriving in the autonomous city overnight."

"Video: TASS/Reuters/Europa Press/EFE
